# Kiwano Hub

> Per-token LLM prices across 58 providers — vendor APIs, MaaS platforms and inference hosts — checked against the vendors' own published pages and dated.

The catalogue is plain static JSON. No key, no auth, no rate limit.

## Docs

- [API contract](https://models.kiwano.cc/api.md): the four JSON files, the sync pattern, every field's shape, the MCP server. Markdown, hand-written, the source of truth.

## Data

- [manifest.json](https://models.kiwano.cc/data/manifest.json): sha256 of each file + the price-table version — fetch first, stop if unchanged
- [catalog.json](https://models.kiwano.cc/data/catalog.json): 58 providers, identity and endpoints
- [models.json](https://models.kiwano.cc/data/models.json): 1353 price rows, one per (provider, model); prices are decimal strings, never numbers
- [news.json](https://models.kiwano.cc/data/news.json): dated notices, keyed (provider_id, model_id)

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://models.kiwano.cc/sitemap.xml): the prerendered provider and model pages
- [MCP server](https://github.com/lightconsen/models/blob/main/scripts/hub-mcp.mjs): the same data in the tool loop
